title: Atlas — Project Hand-over
objective: Project owners can hand a project over to someone else. You are only a collaborator on one of the projects. Take ownership of it anyway.

verifier.condition: A project's ownership is transferred by a signed-in user who is a collaborator and not the project's current owner.

weakness: The ownership-transfer endpoint verifies that the caller belongs to the project (owner or collaborator) instead of that the caller is the owner, while the neighbouring owner-only endpoints check correctly.
seededData: Users alice, tess, carol, ben. Projects p1 'Q4 Launch Plan' (owner tess; alice and ben collaborate), p2 'Brand Guidelines 2.0' (owner carol; ben collaborates), p3 'Pricing Model' (owner tess; no collaborators). In memory; reset with the instance.
hints: The interface shows you what you may do as a collaborator. The API may allow more than the interface does.
Compare how different actions on the same project respond when you attempt them without being the owner — they will not all behave alike.
Find the request the owner's hand-over button sends, and replay it with your own session.
burpNotes: Log in as the collaborator and watch which requests the page makes. The owner's actions exist in the page's script even though you are never shown the buttons for them.
